guides.definition: A flex container lays out direct children as flex items. justify-content works along the main axis and align-items works along the cross axis.

parameters.name: className
parameters.description: The class applied to the flex container.

parameters.name: wrap
parameters.description: Whether items remain on one line or wrap.

parameters.name: align
parameters.description: How items align across the main axis.

parameters.name: justify
parameters.description: How free space is distributed along the main axis.

examples.title: Build a responsive toolbar row
examples.explanation: Items share a row when space permits, wrap when needed, and keep consistent spacing and alignment.
